items.text: I think this game has a huge amount of potential and I can't wait to play it when it's playable - but currently, it's very hard to get into it due to game-breaking bugs. In my first game, the decreasing oxygen concentration in my ship had some sort of rounding error and ended up as "NaN", and couldn't be refilled. In my second game, I saved in my air-tight, oxygenated and entirely safe ship, and when I reloaded the save I died instantly due to hypoxia. I really want to get into this game - I want to carefully fix up a ship and fly it about. But I keep getting prevented from doing that by bugs. I look forward to playing it again when it's a bit more mature.
items.text_zh: 我认为这款游戏潜力巨大，等它能玩的时候我迫不及待想玩——但目前，由于破坏游戏的bug，很难真正投入进去。在我的第一局游戏中，我飞船里不断下降的氧气浓度出现了某种舍入误差，最后变成了“NaN”，而且无法重新填充。在我的第二局游戏中，我在自己气密、供氧且完全安全的飞船里保存，当我重新加载存档时，我因缺氧立刻死亡。我真的很想投入这款游戏——我想仔细修好一艘飞船，然后开着它到处飞。但我总是被bug阻止这么做。我期待等它更成熟一些时再玩。
